status: REVIEW PACK — for the owner's visual review only. Not a production composition, not a promotion, no runtime. R3 stays default OFF.

mode.name: review-pack
mode.rule: Only this explicit review mode may compose DRAFT parts. The production paths are unchanged and keep refusing them: r3-face-parts-tool composeFromSources / validateAnnotation in production mode (APPROVED only), r3-eyes-tool composeEyes (a passed eyes-fixed sheet and an APPROVED annotation), r3-hair-tool-v2 composeHair (a passed raw sheet and an APPROVED annotation). Versioning a file never changes its status.

layerOrder.source: the contract's zModel (D-135): base 0 < face 3 < eyes 4 (iris first, eyes-fixed second, approvedTies) < hair 40

base.provenance: deterministic drawing on the approved G1V3 + E2 + K4 geometry; no H1, no Northstar pixels

hair.provenance: hybrid derivation (D-185) of the generated D-183 sheet under its construction annotation — raw-sheet rules are not applied to the derivation; the nape lock is a deterministic drawing merged under it at authoring time

face.status: DRAFT (brows and mouth: D-165 sheet with DRAFT anchors) + DESIGNFORSLAG (nose)
face.provenance: brows and mouth resampled from their own cells of the untouched generated D-165 sheet with their DRAFT anchors onto the APPROVED D-164 targets (one positive uniform scale + translation per part, least squares); the nose is the authored vector nose-design-v1 rasterised analytically (8x8) on the same targets; order browLeft > browRight > nose > mouth

eyes.provenance: authored vector prototype (no Northstar pixels): the two SVGs are the source; the two PNG layers are their render with headless Chromium (Playwright 1.59.1) and are pinned by hash. The unit CI has no browser, so CI verifies the pinned layers; --render-eyes re-renders them locally and compares pixel hashes.

d165Sheet.status: generated raw sheet, RAW-1..5 passed (D-166); brows and mouth kept for review
d165Sheet.copyOf: the D-165 raw recorded in the contract (authorisedCalls D-165 execution.raw)
